# Conformance

<!-- Generated by `mise run docs:conformance` (scripts/docs/conformance-report.ts). Don't edit by hand. -->

The interpreter is tested against the W3C [SCXML 1.0 Implementation Report Plan](https://www.w3.org/Voice/2013/scxml-irp/)
test suite, converted to the ECMAScript data model. The converted suite is vendored in
[`conformance/`](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance) (W3C licence in [`conformance/LICENSE-W3C`](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/LICENSE-W3C)), so running it needs no network.
A test passes when its session reaches the top-level `<final id="pass">`. Time is virtual, so delayed events
fire instantly and the whole suite runs in well under a second per data model.

Reproduce: `mise run conformance` (sandboxed), `mise run conformance:trusted` (trusted),
`mise run docs:conformance` (this page). `bun test` runs the suite too, in both data models.

## Summary

| | Sandboxed (QuickJS) | Trusted (host engine) |
|---|---|---|
| Mandatory tests | **160/160** | **160/160** |
| Optional tests | 21/33 | 21/33 |
| Manual tests | see [below](#manual-tests) | see [below](#manual-tests) |

Every test that doesn't pass is optional and needs the Basic HTTP Event I/O Processor, which isn't included:
[201](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/201/test201.scxml), [509](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/509/test509.scxml), [510](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/510/test510.scxml), [518](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/518/test518.scxml), [519](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/519/test519.scxml), [520](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/520/test520.scxml), [522](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/522/test522.scxml), [531](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/531/test531.scxml), [532](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/532/test532.scxml), [534](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/534/test534.scxml), [567](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/567/test567.scxml), [577](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/ecma/577/test577.scxml). See [deviations](deviations.md).

## Manual tests

9 tests are marked *manual*: a person reads the output and decides. The verdicts, with the
evidence for each, are in [`conformance/MANUAL.md`](https://github.com/tinyactors-dev/scxmljs/blob/main/conformance/MANUAL.md): 8 pass, and 513 is not
applicable (it needs the Basic HTTP processor). The mechanically checkable ones are also pinned in
`conformance/conformance.test.ts`.

## Deviations

Where the interpreter deliberately differs from the specification, or leaves something out, is listed in
[deviations.md](deviations.md), each item pinned by a test.
